title: Course Description / Maps – Western States 100
claims: The Western States 100 starts in Olympic Valley and finishes in Auburn.
The course is 100.2 miles with an official 18,090 ft climb.
The organiser publishes route and map material; this site does not redistribute a track file.
The course follows historic 1850s mining trails and begins with a climb to Emigrant Pass.
